title.zh: 刑事诉讼法典（规定表格）（撤销）条例 2018

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。

text.en: 1. These Regulations are the Criminal Procedure Code (Prescribed Forms) (Revocation) Regulations 2018 and come into operation on 17 September 2018.
2. The Criminal Procedure Code (Prescribed Forms) Regulations 2010 (G.N. No. S 811/2010) are revoked.

3. Despite regulation 2, Forms 44 to 49 of the Schedule to the Criminal Procedure Code (Prescribed Forms) Regulations 2010 —
(a)continue to apply to an accused in relation to an offence to be tried in the High Court, if the accused was charged with that offence before 17 September 2018; and
(b)may be used, with such modifications as the circumstances of a particular case may require, for the purposes mentioned in those Forms.
